Based on the screenshot, here are the answers to your questions:

## Visible Tabs/Navigation Items
The left sidebar shows the following main navigation categories (which function as tabs):

**Company & Organization:**
- Company
- Offices & WorkLocations
- Organizational Units
- Organization Chart

**Positions & Jobs:**
- Position List
- Job Catalog
- Grades & Levels
- JobLevels

**Employee:**
- Employee Directory
- Employee Onboarding
- Onboarding Checklist
- Disciplinary Records
- Employee Documents
- Employee Assets
- Employee Offboarding

**Requests & Approvals:**
- Pending Approvals (with 2 notifications)
- All Requests

**Documents & Letters:**
- Letter Templates

## Is there a "Kinerja" or "Performance" tab?
**No**, there is **no tab labeled "Kinerja" or "Performance"** visible in this screenshot. The visible menu items are limited to the HR administrative functions listed above.

## What page is this?
This is the **Dashboard page of the Human Resource Base module** in **RekanKerja HR Suite** (version 1.0). 

Specifically:
- **Application**: RekanKerja HR Suite
- **Module**: Human Resource Base (Core employee administration)
- **Company**: PT Mitra Industri Internasional (in TRIAL mode)
- **Current View**: Dashboard (the first item in the sidebar)
- **User**: Tri Handayani

The breadcrumb at the top confirms the path: `RekanKerja > Human Resource Base > cnv3lp > PT Mitra Industri Internasional...`

This appears to be an Indonesian HR management system ("Kinerja" means Performance in Indonesian), but the Performance/Kinerja module is not currently displayed in this particular view of the system.
